label: PF Backlog 227
title: Backend: AI-era operations layer (evals + prompt/model/agent versioning + feedback loop + model-quality observability)
body:
## Problem / why
Traditional SDLC (test -> deploy -> maintain) is not enough for AI products: non-deterministic outputs,
prompt/model versions, drift, and feedback need first-class support in verify (5-7) and operate (13).

## Goal & value
Add the AI-era lifecycle layer so the Product tab can show AI quality + the loop that keeps it good.

## In scope
- **Evals:** offline + online eval sets with thresholds; wire into verify stages and quality gate
  (reuse iterative_evaluator / quality_gate).
- **Versioning:** prompt/model/agent version registry; record which version produced an artifact; A/B.
- **Feedback loop:** user feedback + telemetry -> eval sets -> change requests (change_spec) -> releases.
- **Model-quality observability:** drift/hallucination/toxicity + cost/latency; OTel GenAI (BI-0199);
  reuse observer / post-production / product-analytics / finops.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Verify stages run evals with thresholds (pass/fail recorded); a regression blocks release.
- Every AI artifact records prompt+model versions; a feedback item can open a change request.
- Operate view exposes model-quality + cost/latency metrics.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: eval threshold gate; version stamping; feedback->change link.
- Integration: a model/prompt regression is caught before release.

## Links
BI-0199; post-production/observer/product-analytics; dashboard BI-0149.

## Concrete wiring (from the AI-era SDLC gap review)
- **Evals as a release gate inside the EXISTING verify stages (5-7)** - no new stage: eval sets + thresholds
  run alongside NFR/tests; a regression blocks the quality gate. Reuse/rewire `iterative_evaluator` agent.
- **Prompt/model/agent version stamping** - every AI artifact records the prompt + model + agent version that
  produced it; enable A/B and rollback of prompts/models (extends `model_registry` / `version_manager`).
- **Guardrails on outputs** - moderation/safety checks applied to LLM + media outputs, not just policy docs.
- **Provenance / model-data cards** - emit model/data cards + C2PA content credentials for shipped artifacts.
- **Closed feedback loop** - live telemetry + user feedback -> eval sets -> change requests (`change_spec`)
  -> next release; reuse `growth` / `customer-success` / `product-analytics` / `observer`.
- **Model-quality observability panel** - drift / hallucination / toxicity + cost/latency, surfaced in the
  Product tab (reuse `observer` + OTel GenAI BI-0199).

## Scope guard
This is the *AI-quality discipline around* the existing SDLC - NOT new pipeline stages. Traditional
requirements/design/build/release/support are unchanged.

Today we ALREADY have: tests/NFR/quality gates, `iterative_evaluator`, `version_manager`, `model_registry`,
`observer`, telemetry, `guardian`/`legal-privacy`. This item WIRES them into one loop; it does not rebuild them.
_note: expanded with AI-era SDLC wiring (evals gate in 5-7, version stamping, guardrails, provenance, feedback loop)
